_about: Training configuration for the Bornomala Track A Bengali tokenizer (spec section 9.2 step 1). government_administrative and code_mixed_bn_en have no clean public dataset as of 2026-07 and are omitted; weights below are normalised over the remaining four sources by bntok.corpus.build_configured_corpus, so they need not sum to 1. public_domain_literature is a mix of genuine Wikisource public-domain text (thin, ~90 lines) and Sangraha verified/ben pdf-typed documents used as a formal-register proxy, not confirmed pre-1950 material; see bengali-tokenizer/docs/known-issues.md. vocab_size=64000 is the current recommendation: an ablation across 32k/48k/64k on this same corpus showed fertility recovering monotonically with vocab size, and only 64k beats IndicBERTv2 on fertility and STRR across every held-out register tested (see docs/known-issues.md point 7).
